therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immunomodulatory effects of lenalidomide combined with corticosteroid anti-inflammatory effects and CD20-targeted B-cell depletion
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell lymphoma cell death and immune system modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Response rate (complete response or partial response) at 3 months

results.effect_size: Response rate: Cohort 1: 14/27 participants, Cohort 2: 13/23 participants
results.dose_information: Lenalidomide 10mg daily, Dexamethasone 8mg weekly on days 3,10,17,24, Rituximab 375mg/m2 IV weekly on days 1,8,15,22 during month 3
